conflicts.question: How many days of remote work am I allowed per week?

doc_A.metadata: Source: Employee Handbook v1.0 | Date: Jan 2023 | Status: Board Approved
doc_A.text: Employees are permitted a maximum of 2 days of remote work per week. No exceptions.

doc_B.metadata: Source: Slack Export | Date: Oct 2026 | Status: Informal Chat
doc_B.text: Hey team, just checking in. I think we are all doing 4 days of remote work now right? Sounds good to me.
